scripts.lint-and-format: biome check --write --diagnostic-level=error && bun run --cwd app stylelint
scripts.lint-and-format:ci: biome ci --diagnostic-level=error && bun run --cwd app stylelint:ci
scripts.tsc: bun run --cwd app tsc && bun run --cwd server tsc && bun run --cwd tools/site-admin-extension tsc
scripts.test: bun run --cwd app test && bun run --cwd server test
